description.value: Strathcona Beer Company is a craft brewery and taproom anchored in Vancouver's oldest residential neighbourhood, housed in a purpose-built 12,000 square foot facility that includes a 25-hectolitre brewhouse with five fermenters and five brite tanks — every pint poured is brewed on site. The 67-seat tasting room serves a rotating lineup spanning classic international styles like Premium Pilsner, Belgian Golden Ale, and British IPA alongside seasonal specialties and cask brews. A gourmet pizza kitchen and retail area selling exclusive apparel make it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Strathcona area of East Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 26m. Total: 8 spaces.
